examples.title: enableHapticFeedback13+
examples.description:
enableHapticFeedback(isEnabled: boolean)
Specifies whether to enable haptic feedback.
To enable haptic feedback, you must declare the ohos.permission.VIBRATE permission under requestPermissions in the module.json5 file of the project.

examples.title: Example 1: Setting and Obtaining the Cursor Position
examples.description: This example shows how to set and obtain the caret position using controller, available since API version 8.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Search and Delete Icons
examples.description: This example uses the searchButton (since API version 8), searchIcon (since API version 10), and cancelButton (since API version 10) attributes to show the effect of setting the search and delete icons.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing a Custom Keyboard
examples.description:
This example uses the customKeyboard attribute (available since API version 10) to set the input parameter type in value to CustomBuilder and ComponentContent, respectively, to implement the custom keyboard function.
ComponentContent has been added to the input parameter type of customKeyboard since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Enter Key Type
examples.description: This example uses the enterKeyType property to dynamically switch the enter key type. (This property is available since API version 12.)

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example showcases various text styles by using the lineHeight, letterSpacing, and decoration attributes, which are supported since API version 12.
examples.code:
// xxx.ets
@Entry
@Component
struct SearchExample {
  build() {
    Row() {
      Column() {
        Text('lineHeight').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC)
        Search({value: 'lineHeight unset'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(10)
        Search({value: 'lineHeight 15'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(10).lineHeight(15)
        Search({value: 'lineHeight 30'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(10).lineHeight(30)
        Text('letterSpacing').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC)
        Search({value: 'letterSpacing 0'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(5).letterSpacing(0)
        Search({value: 'letterSpacing 3'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(5).letterSpacing(3)
        Search({value: 'letterSpacing -1'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(5).letterSpacing(-1)
        Text('decoration').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC)
        Search({value: 'LineThrough, Red'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(5)
          .decoration({type: TextDecorationType.LineThrough, color: Color.Red})
        Search({value: 'Overline, Red, DOTTED'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(5)
          .decoration({type: TextDecorationType.Overline, color: Color.Red, style: TextDecorationStyle.DOTTED})
        Search({value: 'Underline, Red, WAVY'})
          .border({ width: 1 }).padding(5)
          .decoration({type: TextDecorationType.Underline, color: Color.Red, style: TextDecorationStyle.WAVY})
      }.height('90%')
    }
    .width('90%')
    .margin(10)
  }
}

examples.title: Example 6: Setting Text Feature Effects
examples.description: This sample uses the fontFeature (available since API version 12) attribute to display text with different font features.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Custom Keyboard Avoidance
examples.description: This example implements the custom keyboard avoidance effect by configuring the KeyboardOptions API (available since API version 12) through the customKeyboard attribute (available since API version 10).

examples.title: Example 8: Setting Text Auto-Adaptation
examples.description: From API version 12 onwards, this example uses the minFontSize and maxFontSize attributes to display the effect of text adaptation.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting Insert and Delete Callbacks
examples.description: In API version 12 and later versions, the onWillInsert, onDidInsert, onWillDelete and onDidDelete APIs are used to implement insertion and deletion. Since API version 15, the onWillChange callback is used to display detailed information about the text content to be changed.

examples.title: Example 10: Setting Custom Menu Extensions
examples.description: This example implements custom menu extension items for text using the editMenuOptions API (available since API version 12), allowing configuration of text content, icons, and callbacks. Menu data can also be configured through the onPrepareMenu callback (available since API version 20).

examples.title: Example 11: Setting a Custom Symbol-Type Cancel Button
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the searchIcon and cancelButton attributes to customize the style of the symbol-type cancel button on the right side of the text box, available since API version 10.

examples.title: Example 12: Setting Whether Text is Copyable
examples.description: In API version 9 and later versions, the copyOption attribute is used to set whether the text can be copied.

examples.title: Example 13: Setting the Horizontal Alignment, Caret Style, and Background Color of the Selected Text
examples.description: This sample shows how to set the text horizontal alignment, caret style, and selected background color using the textAlign (available since API version 9), caretStyle (available since API version 10), and selectedBackgroundColor (available since API version 12) properties.

examples.title: Example 14: Configuring the Text Box to Receive Default Focus and Bring Up the Soft Keyboard
examples.description: This sample shows how to set the default focus and enable the keyboard using the defaultFocus (available since API version 9) and enableKeyboardOnFocus (available since API version 10) properties.

examples.title: Example 15: Disabling the System Context Menu on Selection
examples.description: This sample shows how to hide the system text selection menu by using the selectionMenuHidden property.

examples.title: Example 16: Setting Input Filtering
examples.description: In API version 12 and later versions, this example uses the inputFilter attribute to filter input text.

examples.title: Example 17: Setting Text Selection for a Specified Region
examples.description: This example uses the setTextSelection method (available since API version 12) to set the text in a specified area and the policy for showing or hiding the menu.

examples.title: Example 18: Handling Text Scrolling Events
examples.description: In API version 10 and later versions, this sample uses the onContentScroll event to show how to set the callback for a text scrolling event.

examples.title: Example 19: Setting the Minimum and Maximum Font Scale Factors
examples.description: In API version 18 and later versions, you can set the minimum and maximum font scales by using the minFontScale and maxFontScale parameters. When the system font size is adjusted, the text font size remains within the range defined by minFontScale and maxFontScale. The following example demonstrates how the Search component scales its font size according to system font size changes, within different font size limits.

examples.title: Example 20: Setting Text Stroke
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the stroke width and color for text using the strokeWidth and strokeColor attributes, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 21: Configuring Automatic Spacing Between Chinese and Western Text
examples.description: This example shows how to configure automatic spacing between Chinese and Western characters using the enableAutoSpacing attribute, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 22: Setting the Placeholder Rich Text Style
examples.description: This example illustrates how to set the placeholder rich text style using the setStyledPlaceholder API, available since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 23: Setting Input Method Extension Information
examples.description: This example illustrates how to set input method extension information using the setExtraConfig method of IMEClient, available since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 24: Setting the Color of the Text Box Divider
examples.description: This example shows how to use the dividerColor API to set the color of the text box divider, supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 25: Setting Leading Punctuation Compression
examples.description:
This example uses the compressLeadingPunctuation API to set leading punctuation compression. If a punctuation mark with a space on its left appears at the start of a line, the punctuation mark will be compressed to the left boundary.
The compressLeadingPunctuation API is supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 26: Configuring Automatic Spacing
examples.description:
This example uses the includeFontPadding API to add the spacing of the first and last lines and the fallbackLineSpacing API to set the adaptive line spacing.
The includeFontPadding and fallbackLineSpacing APIs are supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 27: Setting the Drag Preview Style for Text Being Dragged
examples.description:
This example shows how to set the drag preview style for text being dragged using the selectedDragPreviewStyle API.
The selectedDragPreviewStyle API is supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 28: Deleting the Last Character in a Text Box
examples.description:
This example calls the deleteBackward API to delete the last character in the text box.
The deleteBackward API is supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 29: Setting the Text Layout Direction
examples.description:
This example uses the textDirection API to set the text layout direction.
The textDirection API is supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 30: Scrolling the Text in a Specified Range to the Visible Area
examples.description:
This example uses the scrollToVisible API to scroll the text outside the visible area to the visible area.
The scrollToVisible API is supported since API version 23.
